# Public-domain test text

Literary excerpts and names used by the test suite come from the following public-domain works:

- Lewis Carroll, _Alice's Adventures in Wonderland_ (1865). Source transcription:
  Project Gutenberg eBook No. 11, <https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/11>. Carroll died in 1898.
- Natsume Soseki, _Botchan_ (`坊っちゃん`, 1906). Source transcription:
  Aozora Bunko card No. 752, <https://www.aozora.gr.jp/cards/000148/card752.html>. Soseki died
  in 1916.

The original literary text is in the public domain. Short Russian translations in the tests were
written specifically for this repository and are covered by the repository's MIT license. No
published Russian translation is copied.

Project Gutenberg and Aozora Bunko are credited as transcription sources. Their names and service
marks are not part of the test fixtures, and this project is not affiliated with either service.
